commands.review_summary:
Adds a fixed 30-second QQBot WebSocket opening-handshake timeout, updates constructor-option assertions, and adds a real stalled-TCP handshake regression test.

PR surface: Source +6, Tests +86. Total +92 across 3 files.

Reproducibility: yes. from source, with high confidence: current main constructs the QQBot `ws` client without `handshakeTimeout`, while `isConnecting` remains set until an open or close event; the PR's real stalled-TCP run confirms the dependency behavior after the fix. A failing live run against unmodified current main was not supplied, so this is source-reproducible rather than directly reproduced.

target.title: fix(qqbot): bound gateway websocket handshake waits at 30s
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

QQBot gateway websocket creation set headers/proxy agent but not `handshakeTimeout`. `gateway-connection` sets `isConnecting=true` until `open` or `close`; when a peer accepts TCP but never completes the websocket upgrade, that flag stays true forever and reconnect is skipped (`Already connecting, skip`). Slack relay, Mattermost, and Signal already bound handshake waits at 30s.

## Why This Change Was Made

- Bake `handshakeTimeout: 30_000` into `createQQWSClient` via `QQBOT_WEBSOCKET_HANDSHAKE_TIMEOUT_MS`.
- Timeout-induced `close` already clears `isConnecting` and drives `scheduleReconnect` — no gateway-connection logic change.
- Regressions assert constructor wiring and prove a real TCP hang fails at ~30s.

No new config/env surface.

Note: open [#99075](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99075) bounds `maxPayload` in the same factory; this PR only adds handshake timeout and should rebase cleanly after that lands.

## User Impact

**Before:** A QQBot gateway peer that accepted TCP without completing the websocket handshake could pin the channel in a permanent connecting state with no reconnect.

**After:** Handshake waits fail closed after 30s (`Opening handshake has timed out` / close 1006), clearing `isConnecting` so reconnect continues.

## Evidence

- Changed: `extensions/qqbot/src/engine/gateway/ws-client.ts`
- Production caller: `gateway-connection.ts` → `createQQWSClient`
- Sibling: Slack relay / Mattermost / Signal `handshakeTimeout: 30_000`
- Regression: `ws-client.test.ts`, `ws-client.ws-handshake.test.ts`

### Caller-path Vitest

```bash
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/qqbot/src/engine/gateway/ws-client.test.ts extensions/qqbot/src/engine/gateway/ws-client.ws-handshake.test.ts --reporter=verbose
```

```text
 ✓ createQQWSClient > does not set a ws proxy agent when proxy env is absent
 ✓ createQQWSClient > creates a ws proxy agent when lowercase https_proxy is set
 ✓ createQQWSClient > creates a ws proxy agent when uppercase HTTPS_PROXY is set
 ✓ createQQWSClient > falls back to HTTP_PROXY for ws proxy agent creation
 ✓ uses a 30s handshakeTimeout matching Slack relay / Mattermost
[qqbot handshake live proof] timed_out=true elapsed_ms=30006 handshakeTimeout_ms=30000 error=Opening handshake has timed out
 ✓ fails when a peer accepts TCP but never completes the websocket upgrade 30021ms
 Test Files  2 passed (2)
      Tests  6 passed (6)
```

## Real behavior proof

**Commands run:**
```bash
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/qqbot/src/engine/gateway/ws-client.test.ts extensions/qqbot/src/engine/gateway/ws-client.ws-handshake.test.ts --reporter=verbose
```

**Before fix:**
`createQQWSClient` WebSocket options had no `handshakeTimeout`, so a TCP peer that never upgraded could leave `isConnecting=true` forever.

**After fix:**
Production factory wires `handshakeTimeout: 30000`. Against a TCP peer that accepts but never upgrades, real `ws` fails at ~30s.

**Evidence after fix:**
```text
[qqbot handshake live proof] timed_out=true elapsed_ms=30006 handshakeTimeout_ms=30000 error=Opening handshake has timed out
 Test Files  2 passed (2)
      Tests  6 passed (6)
```

**What was not tested:**
Live QQBot gateway credentials; full gateway process packaging beyond the production `ws` client options used by `gateway-connection.ts`.
